question.latex:
Given below are two statements :
Statement $I$ : Oxidising power of halogens decreases in the order $F_2 > Cl_2 > Br_2 > I_2$, which is the basis of "Layer test".
Statement $II$ : "Layer test" to identify $Br_2$ and $I_2$ in aqueous solution involves the oxidation of bromide or iodide into $Br_2$ or $I_2$ respectively with $Cl_2$, which is a type of displacement redox reaction.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

question.plainText: Given below are two statements : Statement I : Oxidising power of halogens decreases in the order F_2 > Cl_2 > Br_2 > I_2, which is the basis of "Layer test". Statement II : "Layer test" to identify Br_2 and I_2 in aqueous solution involves the oxidation of bromide or iodide into Br_2 or I_2 respectively with Cl_2, which is a type of displacement redox reaction. In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.latex: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
options.unicode: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
options.plainText: Both Statement I and Statement II are true

options.latex: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
options.unicode: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
options.plainText: Both Statement I and Statement II are false

options.latex: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.unicode: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.plainText: Statement I is true but Statement II is false

options.latex: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.unicode: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.plainText: Statement I is false but Statement II is true

explanation.latex:
Statement I is correct: The standard reduction potentials (oxidising power) of halogens follow the order $F_2 > Cl_2 > Br_2 > I_2$. The stronger oxidizing halogen can displace the halide ion of a weaker halogen from its salt.
Statement II is correct: The "Layer test" (or carbon disulfide/chloroform test) relies on the fact that chlorine gas or chlorine water is a stronger oxidizing agent than $Br_2$ and $I_2$. Thus, $Cl_2$ oxidizes $Br^-$ to $Br_2$ (orange-red layer) and $I^-$ to $I_2$ (violet layer) which get extracted in the non-polar organic layer. This is indeed a displacement redox reaction.
Both statements are true.
